Title: Hired Auto Liability
Description: Extends liability coverage to autos leased, hired, rented, or borrowed for business use.
RuleText: Coverage applies when a covered auto is hired or rented for business operations, subject to policy limits and terms.

Title: Non-Owned Auto Liability
Description: Extends liability protection to employee-owned or third-party vehicles used for company business.
RuleText: Coverage applies to non-owned autos used in the course of business, provided the vehicle is not regularly furnished to the insured.

Title: Temporary Substitute Auto
Description: Provides coverage for a temporary replacement vehicle when a covered commercial auto is out of service.
RuleText: A temporary substitute auto is covered when the scheduled auto is withdrawn from normal use due to breakdown, repair, servicing, loss, or destruction.

Title: Loading and Unloading Coverage
Description: Covers liability arising from loading or unloading property from a covered commercial vehicle.
RuleText: Coverage applies to covered liability arising directly from loading or unloading operations connected to a covered auto.

Title: Racing or Speed Contest
Description: Excludes losses arising from racing, speed contests, stunt driving, or performance testing.
RuleText: No coverage applies while a covered auto is used in any racing, demolition, speed, or stunt event.

Title: Intentional Vehicle Damage
Description: Excludes intentional damage caused by or at the direction of the insured.
RuleText: No coverage applies to loss or damage expected or intended by the insured or any authorized representative.

Title: Unauthorized Commercial Use
Description: Excludes claims involving vehicle use outside permitted business operations or authorized drivers.
RuleText: No coverage applies when the vehicle is operated by an unauthorized driver or used for an undisclosed commercial activity.

Title: Pollution Release
Description: Excludes pollution liability arising from discharge or release of pollutants from a covered vehicle.
RuleText: No coverage applies to bodily injury, property damage, or cleanup cost arising from pollutant release unless specifically endorsed.

Title: Business Personal Property
Description: Covers business contents, furniture, fixtures, equipment, inventory, and similar property at covered premises.
RuleText: Business personal property is covered at scheduled premises, subject to the applicable limit, deductible, and valuation basis.

Title: Debris Removal
Description: Covers reasonable costs to remove debris after a covered property loss.
RuleText: Debris removal expense is covered when debris results from direct physical loss caused by a covered cause of loss.

Title: Fire Department Service Charge
Description: Covers charges imposed by a fire department responding to a covered property loss.
RuleText: Fire department service charges are covered when incurred because of a covered fire or emergency response at insured premises.

Title: Equipment Breakdown
Description: Covers sudden and accidental breakdown of covered mechanical, electrical, or pressure equipment.
RuleText: Coverage applies to direct physical loss caused by covered equipment breakdown, subject to exclusions and inspection requirements.

Title: Flood Damage
Description: Excludes loss caused by flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, overflow, or waterborne mudslide.
RuleText: No coverage applies to flood or surface water damage unless a flood endorsement or separate flood policy applies.

Title: Earth Movement
Description: Excludes loss caused by earthquake, landslide, mine subsidence, or other earth movement.
RuleText: No coverage applies to earth movement loss unless specifically endorsed for the covered premises.

Title: Wear and Tear
Description: Excludes deterioration, corrosion, rust, latent defect, settling, cracking, and ordinary wear.
RuleText: No coverage applies to loss caused by gradual deterioration, maintenance failure, or inherent vice.

Title: War and Nuclear Hazard
Description: Excludes loss caused by war, military action, nuclear reaction, nuclear radiation, or radioactive contamination.
RuleText: No coverage applies to war or nuclear hazard loss regardless of other contributing causes.

Title: Uninsured Motorist Protection
Description: Provides protection when an insured is injured by an uninsured or underinsured driver.
RuleText: Coverage applies when a legally responsible driver lacks sufficient insurance, subject to state limits and policy terms.

Title: Medical Payments
Description: Covers reasonable medical expenses for covered persons injured in an auto accident.
RuleText: Medical payments coverage applies to eligible expenses incurred within the policy terms, regardless of fault.

Title: Rental Reimbursement
Description: Reimburses rental vehicle costs after a covered physical damage loss to the insured auto.
RuleText: Rental reimbursement applies after a covered loss, subject to daily and maximum limits shown in the policy.

Title: Roadside Assistance
Description: Covers emergency roadside services such as towing, jump start, lockout, and tire change assistance.
RuleText: Roadside assistance applies to covered vehicles when service is needed due to disablement, subject to plan limits.

Title: Commercial Delivery Use
Description: Excludes claims while the personal auto is used for livery, delivery, or compensated transport.
RuleText: No coverage applies while the vehicle is used to carry persons or property for a fee unless endorsed.

Title: Racing or Track Use
Description: Excludes losses during racing, track events, speed trials, or organized performance driving.
RuleText: No coverage applies while the auto is used in any racing, speed, timed, or performance event.

Title: Intentional Loss
Description: Excludes loss intentionally caused by or at the direction of an insured person.
RuleText: No coverage applies to any loss expected or intended by an insured, even if the resulting damage is different than expected.

Title: Unlisted Regular Driver
Description: Excludes coverage where a regular operator is not disclosed or rated on the policy.
RuleText: Coverage may be denied when the vehicle is regularly operated by an undisclosed household member or customary driver.

Title: Dwelling Protection
Description: Covers the residence structure and attached components against covered causes of loss.
RuleText: Dwelling coverage applies to the insured residence premises, attached structures, and covered building materials.

Title: Personal Property
Description: Covers household contents and personal belongings owned or used by an insured.
RuleText: Personal property is covered worldwide, subject to special limits, exclusions, and valuation provisions.

Title: Loss of Use
Description: Covers additional living expenses when the residence is uninhabitable due to covered damage.
RuleText: Loss of use coverage applies when a covered loss makes the residence premises unfit to live in.

Title: Personal Liability
Description: Covers personal liability claims for bodily injury or property damage caused by an insured.
RuleText: Personal liability coverage applies to covered occurrences, subject to exclusions and policy limits.

Title: Flood Damage
Description: Excludes damage caused by flood, surface water, storm surge, or overflow of a body of water.
RuleText: No coverage applies to flood or surface water damage unless a flood endorsement or separate flood policy applies.

Title: Earthquake Damage
Description: Excludes damage caused by earthquake, tremor, landslide, or earth sinking and shifting.
RuleText: No coverage applies to earth movement loss unless earthquake coverage is specifically endorsed.

Title: Wear and Deterioration
Description: Excludes gradual wear, deterioration, rot, corrosion, settling, cracking, and maintenance-related damage.
RuleText: No coverage applies to loss caused by wear and tear, neglect, defective maintenance, or gradual deterioration.

Title: Business Activity Liability
Description: Excludes liability arising from business activities conducted by an insured at the residence.
RuleText: No coverage applies to bodily injury or property damage arising from business pursuits unless specifically endorsed.
